verdict.rationale: Working Copy exposes some programmatic surfaces: Shortcuts automation where files and data flow between actions, a built-in WebDAV server for moving files in and out, and Files-app/document-picker access for third-party apps. Nothing shows these cover the full UI feature set, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs. Missing for 10: evidence of API/automation parity for UI operations (commit editing, squash, rebase config, conflict resolution, tags, stash, PR creation), a documented API reference, and independent confirmation of automation coverage.
